title: Settlement Allowance Extended to Long-Standing Refined Fuels and Propane Accounts
content:
A member who has carried an account under Refined Fuels and Propane Accounts for many years is allowed something against the settlement of it. How long the account has stood open and how much fuel it has taken over the year decide the allowance.

1. Where the account has stood open for at least 10 years and the gallons taken on it over the twelve months ending on the handling date reach 2000 gallons, the settlement allowance is 75.00 USD.
2. Where the account has stood open for at least 10 years and the gallons taken on it over that window fall under 2000 gallons, the settlement allowance is 35.00 USD.
3. Where the account has stood open for fewer than 10 years, the settlement allowance is nothing.

## Reading the two tests

The years are counted from the day the account was opened to the handling date, and the test is met at 10 years exactly. The gallons are the gallons delivered on that account over the twelve months ending on the handling date, and that test too is met at 2000 gallons exactly.

| Years the account has stood open | Gallons taken in the window | Settlement allowance |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 10 or more | 2000 or more | 75.00 USD |
| 10 or more | Under 2000 | 35.00 USD |
| Fewer than 10 | Either way | Nothing |

*Hypothetical, on the boundaries.* An account opened 10 years to the day before the handling date, carrying 2000.0 gallons taken in the window, is allowed 75.00 USD. The same account at 1999.0 gallons is allowed 35.00 USD. An account opened 9 years and 11 months before the handling date is allowed nothing, however many gallons it took.
